name: Whole Bible in a year
short: Genesis to Revelation, about 3–4 chapters a day.
description: Read every chapter of the Bible in order over 365 days. Each day is balanced by length, so long chapters (like Psalm 119) get a day to themselves.

name: New Testament in 90 days
short: Matthew to Revelation, about 3 chapters a day.
description: The life of Jesus, the early church, the letters and Revelation in three months.

name: Gospels in 30 days
short: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John in a month.
description: The four accounts of Jesus' life, death and resurrection, about 3 chapters a day.

name: Psalms and Proverbs in 60 days
short: A few psalms each day, with a chapter of Proverbs on most days.
description: The Bible's songbook and its book of everyday wisdom, read side by side over two months.

name: First steps
short: 21 days: Mark, then some well-loved Psalms, then Genesis 1–12.
description: A gentle start for anyone new to the Bible. Meet Jesus in Mark, pray with some of the best-known Psalms, then go back to the beginning.

name: Chronological Bible in a year
short: The whole Bible in the approximate order events happened.
description: Read the Bible in roughly historical order: Job alongside Genesis, the prophets alongside the kings they spoke to, and Paul's letters alongside Acts. The order is approximate: scholars date some books differently, and the Psalms are read by collection.
